_note: Acknowledgment REJECTED by the receiver's 997. The errors[] entry is verbatim from the acknowledgment API example in the docs.

errors.message: Purchase order references an unknown ship-to location

customer_note: Orderful shows Valid and Delivered but Acme rejected it. Whose problem is this?

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ship-to DC-0417 opened on August 25 and the partner's location master was last updated July 1, so their backend rejects the unknown location
hypotheses.check: Ask Acme Foods whether DC-0417 exists in their customer location master

hypotheses.hypothesis: The N104 qualifier 92 is not what this partner expects for ship-to codes
hypotheses.check: Compare N103 on a previously accepted PO to a different ship-to

mock_result.customer_reply: The PO reached Acme Foods, which is why it shows Delivered. Their system then rejected it because it does not recognize ship-to DC-0417, which you opened on August 25. This is a setup gap on Acme's side, not a formatting problem. Once they add DC-0417, resend the PO and it will be accepted. We are happy to contact their EDI team with you.

ticket_two.title: Validate ship-to codes against the partner's location list before sending
ticket_two.why: A lookup table of accepted ship-to codes per partner, checked by a rule on outbound 850, turns a next-day 997 rejection into an immediate validation error the customer can fix.
